what: Post-hoc fixes after the held-out run on Contextual AI ExtractBench. NOT held-out: they were found by reading that run's failures. Each is generic (reads only the document, the schema and the tool output; no label).

fixes.F1: wholedoc.ocr_text_layer / imgview.npages decode tool output leniently (Shift-JIS font names crashed the whole-document reading)
fixes.F2: agentic.run_case + wholedoc.extract_partitioned(text_windows=True): a text document too long for one call whose schema has no top-level array is read in windows of its text (DQ_TEXT_WINDOWS, DQ_TEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS=60000)
fixes.F3: agentic.run_case: a list of plain values is read as {value: ...} records under the item's own schema and unwrapped (DQ_SCALAR_LISTS)
fixes.F4: conform: drop a null the schema does not admit in an optional property, drop null items from lists that do not admit them, add a missing required object/list empty (DQ_SCHEMA_VALID)

effect_elsewhere: LlamaIndex ExtractBench (370 docs): F4 changes no stored final output; F1-F3 change no routing decision (checked offline for every document, including the whole-document fallbacks in the logs). UNIKIE: template schemas admit null everywhere and every image fits one call, so none applies. Their reported numbers stand unchanged.
